title: kate-search: find-bar query and replace-one transaction
summary: FindBar builds a SearchQuery and replaces one hit or every hit. Plain replacement does not expand a dollar sign. Regex replacement uses the existing expander. This packet does not draw a bar and does not edit kate-ui. It does not add a dependency. Linux CI runs the tests.

lane.reason: The type is pure Rust in kate-search. It does not need a window or the owner's eyes. Linux CI is the test run. Also run cargo check for aarch64-apple-darwin.

definitions.definition:
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum FindMode { Plain, EscapeSequences, Regex }

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct FindBar {
    pub pattern: String,
    pub replacement: String,
    pub mode: FindMode,
    pub case_sensitive: bool,
    pub whole_words: bool,
    pub backwards: bool,
}

impl FindBar {
    pub fn query(&self) -> crate::SearchQuery
    pub fn find_from(&self, buf: &kate_text::TextBuffer, from: kate_text::Offset) -> Result<Option<crate::Match>, crate::SearchError>
    pub fn replace_one(&self, buf: &kate_text::TextBuffer, hit: &crate::Match) -> Result<kate_text::Transaction, crate::SearchError>
    pub fn replace_all(&self, buf: &kate_text::TextBuffer) -> Result<(kate_text::Transaction, usize), crate::SearchError>
}

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: lib.rs adds mod bar and re-exports FindMode and FindBar. query maps the three modes onto Pattern. It copies case_sensitive, whole_words, and a range of None. find_from calls find_next with wrap false and the backwards flag. replace_all calls the existing replace_all. replace_one builds one edit for that hit. A plain pattern copies the replacement. A regex or escape replace_one calls escape::expand and passes the capture names. replace_all uses that same call. Do not call the public expand_replacement for a regex hit. Do not change find_next or replace_all. Do not add a dependency. A new Rust file starts with the LGPL-2.1-or-later SPDX header. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: bar::tests::plain_replacement_keeps_a_dollar
regression_tests.asserts: A plain pattern a and a replacement of $1 replaces a with the two characters dollar and 1.

regression_tests.name: bar::tests::replace_one_expands_a_regex_group
regression_tests.asserts: The regex (c)at and the replacement $1 replace cat with c. replace_one calls escape::expand with the capture names. An invalid regex returns InvalidRegex from find_from.

regression_tests.name: bar::tests::find_from_walks_backward_without_wrap
regression_tests.asserts: In aba, find_from at offset 3 with backwards true returns the match at offset 2. wrap is false, so a search at offset 0 backward returns None.
